1.1: Sukka shehi gevoha lemala meesrim amma, pesula. rabbi yehuda machshir. vesheenah gevoha asara tefachim, vesheen lah shelosha defanot, veshechammatah merubba mitztzillatah, pesula. sukka yeshana, bet shammay poslin, uvet hillel machshirin. veezo hi sukka yeshana, kol sheasaah kodem lechag sheloshim yom. aval im asaah leshem chag, afillu mittechillat hashshana, keshera:
1.2: Haose sukkato tachat hailan, keillu asaah betoch habbayit. sukka al gabbe sukka, haelyona cheshera, vehattachtona pesula. rabbi yehuda omer, im en diyyurin baelyona, hattachtona keshera:
1.3: Peras aleha sadin mippene hachamma, o tachteha mippene hanneshar, o shepperas al gabbe hakkinof, pesula. aval pores hu al gabbe naklite hammitta:
1.4: Hidla aleha et haggefen veet haddelaat veet hakkissom vesikkech al gabbah, pesula. veim haya sikkuch harebe mehen, o shekketzatzan, keshera. ze hakkelal, kol shehu mekabbel tuma veen giddulo min haaretz, en mesakkechin bo. vechol davar sheeno mekabbel tuma vegiddulo min haaretz, mesakkechin bo:
1.5: Chavile kash vachavile etzim vachavile zeradin, en mesakkechin bahen. vechullan shehittiran, kesherot. vechullan kesherot laddefanot:
1.6: Mesakkechin binsarim, divre rabbi yehuda. verabbi meir oser. natan aleha neser shehu rachav arbaa tefachim, keshera, uvilvad shelo yishan tachtav:
1.7: Tikra sheen aleha maaziva, rabbi yehuda omer, bet shammay omrim, mefakpek venotel achat mibbentayim, uvet hillel omrim, mefakpek o notel achat mibbentayim. rabbi meir omer, notel achat mibbentayim, veen mefakpek:
1.8: Hamekare sukkato veshappudin o vaarukkot hammitta, im yesh revach benehen kemotan, keshera. hachotet begadish laasot bo sukka, enah sukka:
1.9: Hameshalshel defanot milmala lematta, im gavoah min haaretz shelosha tefachim, pesula. millematta lemala, im gavoah min haaretz asara tefachim, keshera. rabbi yose omer, keshem shemmillematta lemala asara tefachim, kach milmala lematta asara tefachim. hirchik et hassikkuch min haddefanot shelosha tefachim, pesula:
1.10: Bayit shennifchat vesikkech al gabbav, im yesh min hakkotel lassikkuch arba ammot, pesula. vechen chatzer shehi mukkefet achsadra. sukka gedola, shehikkifuha vedavar sheen mesakkechim bo, im yesh tachtav arba ammot, pesula:
1.11: Haose sukkato kemin tzerif, o shessemachah lechotel, rabbi eliezer posel, mippene sheen lah gag, vachachamim machshirin. machtzelet kanim gedola, asaah lishchiva, mekabbelet tuma veen mesakkechin bah. lesikkuch, mesakkechin bah veenah mekabbelet tuma. rabbi eliezer omer, achat ketanna veachat gedola, asaah lishchiva, mekabbelet tuma veen mesakkechin bah. lesikkuch, mesakkechin bah veenah mekabbelet tuma:

2.1: Hayyashen tachat hammitta vassukka, lo yatza yede chovato. amar rabbi yehuda, nohagin hayinu, shehayinu yeshenim tachat hammitta bifne hazzekenim, velo amru lanu davar. amar rabbi shimon, maase vetavi avdo shel rabban gamliel shehaya yashen tachat hammitta, veamar lahen rabban gamliel lazzekenim, reitem tavi avdi, shehu talmid chacham veyodea sheavadim peturin min hassukka, lefichach yashen hu tachat hammitta. ulefi darkenu lamadnu, shehayyashen tachat hammitta, lo yatza yede chovato:
2.2: Hassomech sukkato bechare hammitta, keshera. rabbi yehuda omer, im enah yechola laamod bifne atzmah, pesula. sukka hameduvlelet, veshetztzillatah merubba mechammatah, keshera. hameubba chemin bayit, af al pi sheen hakkochavim nirim mittochah, keshera:
2.3: Haose sukkato berosh haagala o berosh hassefina, keshera, veolin lah beyom tov. berosh hailan o al gabbe gamal, keshera, veen olin lah beyom tov. shetayim bailan veachat bide adam, o shetayim bide adam veachat bailan, keshera, veen olin lah beyom tov. shalosh bide adam veachat bailan, keshera, veolin lah beyom tov. ze hakkelal, kol shennittal hailan vichola laamod bifne atzmah, keshera, veolin lah beyom tov:
2.4: Haose sukkato ben hailanot, vehailanot defanot lah, keshera. sheluche mitzva peturin min hassukka. cholin umeshammeshehen peturin min hassukka. ochlin veshotin aray chutz lassukka:
2.5: Maase veheviu lo lerabban yochanan ben zakkay litom et hattavshil, ulerabban gamliel shete chotavot udeli shel mayim, veamru, haalum lassukka. ucheshennatnu lo lerabbi tzadok ochel pachot mikkabbetza, netalo vammappa vaachalo chutz lassukka, velo verach acharav:
2.6: Rabbi eliezer omer, arba esre seudot chayyav adam leechol bassukka, achat bayyom veachat ballayla. vachachamim omrim, en laddavar kitzva, chutz millele yom tov rishon shel chag bilvad. veod amar rabbi eliezer, mi shello achal lele yom tov harishon, yashlim belele yom tov haacharon. vachachamim omrim, en laddavar tashlumin, al ze neemar (Kohelet 1) meuvvat lo yuchal litkon, vechesron lo yuchal lehimmanot:
2.7: Mi shehaya rosho verubbo vassukka, veshulchano vetoch habbayit, bet shammay poslin, uvet hillel machshirin. amru lahen bet hillel levet shammay, lo chach haya maase, shehalchu zikne vet shammay vezikne vet hillel levakker et rabbi yochanan ben hachorani, umetzauhu shehaya yoshev rosho verubbo vassukka, veshulchano vetoch habbayit, velo amru lo davar. amru lahen bet shammay, mishsham reaya, af hem amru lo, im ken hayita noheg, lo kiyyamta mitzvat sukka miyyamecha:
2.8: Nashim vaavadim uketannim, peturim min hassukka. katan sheeno tzarich leimmo, chayyav bassukka. maase veyalda challato shel shammay hazzaken ufichet et hammaaziva vesikkech al gabbe hammitta bishvil hakkatan:
2.9: Kol shivat hayyamim adam ose sukkato keva uveto aray. yardu geshamim, meematay muttar lefannot, mishshettisrach hammikpa. mashlu mashal, lema haddavar dome, leeved shebba limzog kos lerabbo, veshafach lo kiton al panav:

3.1: Lulav haggazul vehayyavesh, pasul. shel ashera veshel ir hanniddachat, pasul. niktam rosho, nifretzu alav, pasul. nifredu alav, kasher. rabbi yehuda omer, yeegdennu milmala. tzinne har habbarzel, kesherot. lulav sheyyesh bo shelosha tefachim kede lenanea bo, kasher:
3.2: Hadas haggazul vehayyavesh, pasul. shel ashera veshel ir hanniddachat, pasul. niktam rosho, nifretzu alav o shehayu anavav merubbot mealav, pasul. veim miatan, kasher. veen memaatin beyom tov:
3.3: Arava gezula vivesha, pesula. shel ashera veshel ir hanniddachat, pesula. niktam roshah, nifretzu aleha, vehatztzaftzafa, pesula. kemusha, veshennashru miktzat aleha, veshel baal, keshera:
3.4: Rabbi yishmael omer, shelosha hadassim ushete aravot, lulav echad veetrog echad, afillu shenayim ketumim veechad eno katum. rabbi tarfon omer, afillu shelashtan ketumim. rabbi akiva omer, keshem shellulav echad veetrog echad, kach hadas echad vaarava echat:
3.5: Etrog haggazul vehayyavesh, pasul. shel ashera veshel ir hanniddachat, pasul. shel arla, pasul. shel teruma temea, pasul. shel teruma tehora, lo yittol, veim natal, kasher. shel demay, bet shammay poslin, uvet hillel machshirin. shel maaser sheni birushalayim, lo yittol, veim natal, kasher:
3.6: Alta chazazit al rubbo, nittela fitmato, niklaf, nisdak, nikkav vechasar kol shehu, pasul. alta chazazit al miuto, nittal uktzo, nikkav velo chasar kol shehu, kasher. etrog hakkushi, pasul. vehayarok kecharti, rabbi meir machshir, verabbi yehuda posel:
3.7: Shiur etrog hakkatan, rabbi meir omer, kaegoz. rabbi yehuda omer, kabbetza. uvegadol, kede sheyyochaz shenayim beyado achat, divre rabbi yehuda. rabbi yose omer, afillu echad bishte yadav:
3.8: En ogdin et hallulav ella vemino, divre rabbi yehuda. rabbi meir omer, afillu vimshicha. amar rabbi meir, maase veanshe yerushalayim, shehayu ogdin et lulevehen begimoniyyot shel zahav. amru lo, bemino hayu ogdin oto millematta:
3.9: Vehechan hayu menanein, behodu laAdonai techilla vasof, uveanna Adonai hoshia na, divre vet hillel. uvet shammay omrim, af beanna Adonai hatzelicha na. amar rabbi akiva, tzofe hayiti verabban gamliel uverabbi yehoshua, shekkol haam hayu menaneim et lulevehen, vehen lo nineu ella veanna Adonai hoshia na. mi shebba vadderech velo haya veyado lulav littol, lichsheyyikkanes leveto yittol al shulchano. lo natal shacharit, yittol ben haarbayim, shekkol hayyom kasher lallulav:
3.10: Mi shehaya eved o ishsha o katan makrin oto, one acharehen ma shehen omrin, utehi lo meera. im haya gadol makre oto, one acharav haleluyah:
3.11: Makom shennahagu lichpol, yichpol. lifshot, yifshot. levarech acharav, yevarech acharav. hakkol keminhag hammedina. hallokeach lulav mechavero vashsheviit, noten lo etrog bemattana, lefi sheen rashshay lelakcho vashsheviit:
3.12: Barishona haya lulav nittal bammikdash shiva, uvammedina yom echad. mishshecharav bet hammikdash, hitkin rabban yochanan ben zakkay sheyyehe lulav nittal bammedina shiva, zecher lammikdash. vesheyyehe yom hanef kullo asur:
3.13: Yom tov harishon shel chag shechal lihyot beshabbat, kol haam molichin et lulevehen levet hakkeneset. lammochorat mashkimin uvain, kol echad veechad makkir et shello, venotlo. mippene sheamru chachamim, en adam yotze yede chovato beyom tov harishon shel chag belulavo shel chavero. ushear yemot hechag, adam yotze yede chovato belulavo shel chavero:
3.14: Rabbi yose omer, yom tov harishon shel chag shechal lihyot beshabbat, veshachach vehotzi et hallulav lirshut harabbim, patur, mippene shehotzio virshut:
3.15: Mekabbelet ishsha miyyad benah umiyyad balah umachazirato lammayim beshabbat. rabbi yehuda omer, beshabbat machazirin, beyom tov mosifin, uvammoed machalifin. katan hayyodea lenanea, chayyav ballulav:

4.1: Lulav vaarava, shishsha veshiva. hahallel vehassimcha, shemona. sukka venissuch hammayim, shiva. vehechalil, chamishsha veshishsha:
4.2: Lulav shiva ketzad, yom tov harishon shel chag shechal lihyot beshabbat, lulav shiva, ushear kol hayyamim, shishsha:
4.3: Arava shiva ketzad, yom shevii shel arava shechal lihyot beshabbat, arava shiva, ushear kol hayyamim shishsha:
4.4: Mitzvat lulav ketzad. yom tov harishon shel chag shechal lihyot beshabbat, molichin et lulevehen lehar habbayit, vehachazzanin mekabbelin mehen vesodrin otan al gav haitztabba, vehazzekenim mannichin et shellahen ballishka. umelammedim otam lomar, kol mi shemmaggia lulavi veyado, hare hu lo vemattana. lemachar mashkimin uvain, vehachazzanin zorkin otam lifnehem. vehen mechattefin umakkin ish et chavero. uchesherau vet din shebbau lide sakkana, hitkinu sheyyehe chol echad veechad notel beveto:
4.5: Mitzvat arava ketzad, makom haya lematta mirushalayim, venikra motza. yordin lesham umelakketin mishsham murbiyyot shel arava, uvain vezokfin otan betzidde hammizbeach, verashehen kefufin al gabbe hammizbeach. taku veheriu vetakau. bechol yom makkifin et hammizbeach paam achat, veomrim, anna Adonai hoshia na, anna Adonai hatzelicha na. rabbi yehuda omer, ani vaho hoshia na. veoto hayyom makkifin et hammizbeach sheva peamim. bishat petiratan, ma hen omrim, yofi lecha mizbeach, yofi lecha mizbeach. rabbi eliezer omer, leyah ulecha, mizbeach. leyah ulecha, mizbeach:
4.6: Kemaasehu vechol kach maasehu veshabbat, ella shehayu melakketin otan meerev shabbat umannichim otan begigiyyot shel zahav, kede shello yichmoshu. rabbi yochanan ben beroka omer, chariyyot shel dekel hayu meviin, vechovtin otan bakkarka betzidde hammizbeach, veoto hayyom nikra yom chibbut chariyyot:
4.7: Miyyad hattinokot shomtin et lulevehen veochlin etrogehen:
4.8: Hahallel vehassimcha shemona ketzad. melammed shechayyav adam bahallel uvassimcha uvichvod yom tov haacharon shel chag, kishar kol yemot hechag. sukka shiva ketzad. gamar milleechol, lo yattir sukkato, aval morid et hakkelim min hammincha ulemala, mippene chevod yom tov haacharon shel chag:
4.9: Nissuch hammayim ketzad. tzelochit shel zahav machazeket sheloshet luggim haya memalle min hashshilloach. higgiu leshaar hammayim, taku veheriu vetakau. ala vakkevesh ufana lismolo, shene sefalim shel kesef hayu sham. rabbi yehuda omer, shel sid hayu, ella shehayu mushcharin penehem mippene hayyayin. umenukkavin kemin shene chotamin dakkin, echad meubbe veechad dak, kede sheyyehu shenehem kalin bevat achat. maaravi shel mayim, mizrachi shel yayin. era shel mayim letoch shel yayin, veshel yayin letoch shel mayim, yatza. rabbi yehuda omer, belog haya menassech kol shemona. velamnassech omrim lo, hageba yadecha, sheppaam achat nissech echad al gabbe raglav, uregamuhu chol haam beetrogehen:
4.10: Kemaasehu vechol kach maasehu veshabbat, ella shehaya memalle meerev shabbat chavit shel zahav sheenah mekuddeshet, min hashshilloach, umannichah ballishka. nishpecha o nitgalleta, haya memalle min hakkiyyor, shehayyayin vehammayim hammegullin, pesulim legabbe hammizbeach:

5.1: Hechalil chamishsha veshishsha. zehu hechalil shel bet hashshoeva, sheena docha lo et hashshabbat velo et yom tov. amru, kol mi shello raa simchat bet hashshoeva, lo raa simcha miyyamav:
5.2: Bemotzae yom tov harishon shel chag, yardu leezrat nashim, umetakkenin sham tikkun gadol. umenorot shel zahav hayu sham, vearbaa sefalim shel zahav berashehen, vearbaa sullamot lechol echad veechad, vearbaa yeladim mippirche chehunna uvidehem kaddim shel shemen shel mea veesrim log, shehen mattilin lechol sefel vasefel:
5.3: Mibbelae michnese chohanim umehemyanehen mehen hayu mafkiin, uvahen hayu madlikin, velo hayta chatzer birushalayim sheenah meira meor bet hashshoeva:
5.4: Chasidim veanshe maase hayu merakkedim lifnehem baavukot shel or shebbidehen, veomrim lifnehen divre shirot vetishbachot. vehaleviyyim bechinnorot uvinvalim uvimtziltayim uvachatzotzrot uvichle shir belo mispar, al chamesh esre maalot hayyordot meezrat yisrael leezrat nashim, keneged chamishsha asar shir hammaalot shebbattehillim, shealehen leviyyim omdin bichle shir veomrim shira. veamdu shene chohanim bashshaar haelyon sheyyored meezrat yisrael leezrat nashim, ushete chatzotzrot bidehen. kara haggever, taku veheriu vetakau. higgiu lemala asirit, taku veheriu vetakau. higgiu laazara, taku veheriu vetakau. hayu tokin veholchin, ad shemmaggiin lashshaar hayyotze mizrach. higgiu lashshaar hayyotze mimmizrach, hafchu fenehen lammaarav, veamru, avotenu shehayu vammakom hazze achorehem el hechal Adonai ufenehem kedma, vehemma mishtachavim kedma lashshamesh, veanu leyah enenu. rabbi yehuda omer, hayu shonin veomrin, anu leyah, uleyah enenu:
5.5: En pochatin meesrim veachat tekiot bammikdash, veen mosifin al arbaim ushemone. bechol yom hayu sham esrim veachat tekiot bammikdash, shalosh liftichat shearim, vetesha letamid shel shachar, vetesha letamid shel ben haarbayim. uvammusafin hayu mosifin od tesha. uveerev shabbat hayu mosifin od shesh, shalosh lehavetil haam mimmelacha, veshalosh lehavedil ben kodesh lechol. erev shabbat shebbetoch hechag hayu sham arbaim ushemone, shalosh liftichat shearim, shalosh lashshaar haelyon, veshalosh lashshaar hattachton, veshalosh lemilluy hammayim, veshalosh al gabbe mizbeach, tesha letamid shel shachar, vetesha letamid shel ben haarbayim, vetesha lammusafin, shalosh lehavetil et haam min hammelacha, veshalosh lehavedil ben kodesh lechol:
5.6: Yom tov harishon shel chag hayu sham shelosha asar parim, veelim shenayim, vesair echad. nishtayyeru sham arbaa asar kevasim lishmone mishmarot. bayyom harishon, shishsha makrivin shenayim shenayim, vehashshear echad echad. bashsheni, chamishsha makrivin shenayim shenayim, vehashear echad echad. bashshelishi, arbaa makrivin shenayim shenayim, vehashear echad echad. barvii, shelosha makrivin shenayim shenayim, vehashshear echad echad. bachamishshi, shenayim makrivin shenayim shenayim, vehashshear echad echad. bashshishshi, echad makriv shenayim, vehashshear echad echad. bashshevii, kullan shavin. bashshemini, chazru lappayis kevargalim. amru, mi shehikriv parim hayyom, lo yakriv lemachar, ella chozrin chalila:
5.7: Bishlosha ferakim bashshana hayu kol mishmarot shavot beemure hargalim uvechilluk lechem happanim. baatzeret omrim lo, helach matztza helach chametz. mishmar shezzemanno kavua, hu makriv temidin, nedarim unedavot ushear karbenot tzibbur, umakriv et hakkol. yom tov hassamuch leshabbat, ben millefaneha ben milleachareha, hayu chol hammishmarot shavot bechilluk lechem happanim:
5.8: Chal lihyot yom echad lehafesik bentayim, mishmar shezzemanno kavua, haya notel eser challot, vehammitakkev notel shetayim. uvishar yemot hashshana, hannichnas notel shesh, vehayyotze notel shesh. rabbi yehuda omer, hannichnas notel sheva, vehayyotze notel chamesh. hannichnasin cholkin batztzafon, vehayyotzin baddarom. bilga leolam choleket baddarom, vetabbatah kevua, vechallonah setuma:
